changelog:
Initial release of boss-resume-crawler.

- Supports batch crawling of Boss直聘 job details, including security_id and job description
- Implements PUA salary decoding and incremental deduplication
- Provides strict dependency checks (Python3, websocket-client, CDP connection via CloakBrowser)
- Enforces manual login verification before crawling begins
- Features resilient crawling logic: randomized delays, per-job CSV append, error logging and automatic retries
- Includes detailed usage instructions, performance benchmarks, error handling, and anti-scraping precautions
summary: 从 Boss 直聘批量爬取职位详情（含 security_id、职位描述），支持 PUA 薪资解码和增量去重。
